title: Sierra Leone Country Climate and Development Report
temporal_coverage: Historical baseline, 1995-2014 climate reference, school flood data through 2022, and climate/poverty projections to 2050
methodology: CCDR combines climate scenarios and household-linked poverty modeling.
limitations: Rainfall projections are uncertain; poverty results depend on growth and adaptation assumptions.

title: NDC 3.0 of the Republic of Sierra Leone
organization: Republic of Sierra Leone; submitted to the UNFCCC
temporal_coverage: NDC 3.0 risk analysis and planned climate actions for 2025-2035
methodology: Government NDC presents a qualitative conflict-sensitive climate-risk framework and adaptation measures.
limitations: The conflict-risk discussion is a policy framing and illustrative mechanism, not a quantified causal or local empirical assessment.

title: Climate and Health Vulnerability Assessment: Sierra Leone
organization: World Bank Group and Climate Investment Funds, with Sierra Leone Ministry of Health and Sanitation
temporal_coverage: Observed climate data through 2020; hazard and health-system inputs from varying years; CMIP5 projections for the 2030s and 2050s.
methodology: Assessment combines CRU observations, CMIP5 projections, and health/climate data.
limitations: PDF copyright 2023 differs from filename 2024; exact publication year unresolved. Dated health/admin inputs and limited drought surveillance constrain present-day interpretation.

title: Disaster Risk Financing Strategy and Implementation Plan 2024-2029
organization: Government of Sierra Leone, Ministry of Finance
temporal_coverage: Historical disaster experience through 2022; strategy and implementation period 2024-2029.
methodology: Government strategy compiles NDMA hazard calendars, prior risk assessments and historical disaster-loss data.
limitations: Records are uneven; mapped hazards and losses are not climate-attribution estimates.

title: Sierra Leone Common Country Analysis 2023
organization: United Nations Country Team in Sierra Leone
geographic_coverage: Guinea and Liberia transboundary river basins
temporal_coverage: Country conditions and climate-related sector risks summarized in the 2023 common country analysis; some historical conflict and migration context is included.
methodology: UN Country Team multi-sector synthesis of country context, sector data, policy materials and climate-risk information.
limitations: The analysis calls for better geographically and sex/age-disaggregated data; its climate annex is largely national and does not estimate local conflict effects.

title: Multilateral peacebuilding in practice: addressing farmer-herder disputes along the border of Sierra Leone and Guinea
organization: International Security and Development Center; Thissen et al.
temporal_coverage: 2026 research publication summarizing a UN Peacebuilding Fund-supported cross-border project and its evaluation.
methodology: The accessible research summary reports satellite imagery, a household survey and qualitative interviews.
limitations: Only the institute's article summary was accessible; detailed sample, effect sizes and subgroup results could not be checked in the full paper.

title: Sierra Leone, Asset creation and livelihood: evaluation
temporal_coverage: Asset creation and livelihood activities January 2020-December 2023; the page says evaluation fieldwork ran July 2023-July 2024.
methodology: WFP publication page provides a summary of a decentralized evaluation of asset creation and livelihood activities.
limitations: The page date predates its stated evaluation end date; only the online summary was accessible, with no district disaggregation or underlying sample details.
